integrity: The exact value 16 is prior work. The new claim is the complete equality classification, Fano-deletion characterization, labeled count, and natural-group orbit/stabilizer. The proof is self-contained and the finite census is independently replayable from the embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to length-two six-symbol overline-2-separable codes. It does not classify larger alphabets or unbalanced Zarankiewicz instances. The 2000 small-Zarankiewicz paper was only available through abstract/metadata during this review, leaving a residual bibliographic risk of an unindexed equality-case remark.
title: Uniqueness of the optimum six-symbol length-two 2-separable code
